pages.title: About GuideHollow | GuideHollow
pages.description: GuideHollow is an independent English-language resource for understanding AI, writing useful prompts, and building thoughtful everyday workflows.

pages.title: How to Get Started with ChatGPT | GuideHollow
pages.description: Start with a small, verifiable ChatGPT task, review your data settings, and learn a repeatable way to improve an answer without relying on changing UI details.

pages.title: How to Use ChatGPT Search and Check Its Sources | GuideHollow
pages.description: Choose a bounded web question, open the sources behind a ChatGPT Search answer, and keep a short evidence record before reusing the result.

pages.title: AI Tool Guides | GuideHollow
pages.description: Get oriented in AI tools with careful walkthroughs and realistic expectations.

pages.title: Contact GuideHollow | GuideHollow
pages.description: Report a broken link, suggest an article correction, or ask a question about GuideHollow through GuideHollow’s available contact channels.

pages.title: Editorial Policy | GuideHollow
pages.description: How GuideHollow selects topics, uses official sources and AI assistance, distinguishes examples from testing, and handles corrections.

pages.title: AI Privacy Basics for Everyday Users | GuideHollow
pages.description: Work through a fictional customer record to remove identifiers, preserve useful context, and check an AI-ready input before sharing it.

pages.title: How to Get AI to Output Valid JSON Without Inventing Missing Data | GuideHollow
pages.description: Make AI return valid JSON without inventing values. Learn a source-bounded prompt, a two-ticket example, JSON syntax checks, schema rules, and a fact audit.

pages.title: How to Extract Meeting Action Items with AI Without Inventing Deadlines | GuideHollow
pages.description: Turn approved meeting notes into a reliable AI-assisted action tracker without fabricating owners, due dates, or decisions.

images.alt: Approved meeting notes move through three verification questions to a factual action summary, while unapproved suggestions remain excluded.

pages.title: How to Draft and Improve Emails with AI | GuideHollow
pages.description: Compare complete email drafts and revisions, checking that deadlines, conditions, placeholders, and commitments survive changes in tone.

pages.title: How to Summarize Documents with AI and Check What Was Omitted | GuideHollow
pages.description: Create an evidence-linked summary by defining the reader’s decision, preserving section references, and checking omissions against the original document.

pages.title: How to Use AI for Spreadsheet Tasks Safely | GuideHollow
pages.description: Ask AI for a formula you can inspect, test it against a tiny known dataset, and protect the original workbook before applying it to real rows.

pages.title: How to Verify AI-Generated Information | GuideHollow
pages.description: Use a claim-by-claim review to check AI answers against primary sources, dates, calculations, and the exact decision you need to make.

pages.title: Guides | GuideHollow
pages.description: Clear explanations and practical workflows, from your first AI conversation to everyday productivity.

pages.title: How to Spot Prompt Injection in Documents and Web Pages | GuideHollow
pages.description: Learn to recognize prompt injection in documents, emails, and web pages with concrete examples, a trust-boundary worksheet, and practical safety checks.

pages.title: What Is Generative AI? A Beginner’s Guide | GuideHollow
pages.description: Understand what generative AI creates, how a language model fits into the picture, and how to choose a useful first task without trusting it blindly.

images.alt: Three steps for a first AI task: provide fictional notes, ask for a draft, then verify details and mark the unknown location rather than making one up.

pages.title: GuideHollow — A clearer path through AI.
pages.description: Practical AI guides, reusable prompts, and free tools. Understand the basics, build better workflows, and check what AI gets wrong.

pages.title: Privacy Policy | GuideHollow
pages.description: Understand what GuideHollow stores locally, how browser tools and search work, and what GitHub Pages and external links may collect.

pages.title: A Practical AI Prompt Framework | GuideHollow
pages.description: Use a lightweight Goal–Inputs–Boundaries–Output framework to organize multi-part AI tasks and make missing information visible before drafting.

pages.title: How to Build Reusable Prompt Templates | GuideHollow
pages.description: Separate stable instructions from changing inputs, define required fields, and check a prompt template against ordinary, sparse, and conflicting examples.

pages.title: How to Write Better AI Prompts | GuideHollow
pages.description: Turn an ambiguous request into a clear task with relevant context, checkable constraints, and an output format you can evaluate.

pages.title: Prompt Library | GuideHollow
pages.description: Adaptable prompts and methods that make your instructions clearer and your results easier to review.

pages.title: How to Test AI Prompts with a Small Evaluation Dataset | GuideHollow
pages.description: Build a practical AI prompt evaluation with eight fictional test cases, a scoring rubric, two candidate prompts, and a reusable regression checklist.

pages.title: Search Guides | GuideHollow
pages.description: Search GuideHollow articles, prompts, tools, and troubleshooting guides. Find a clear next step for your AI questions.

checks.label: Every source item has exactly one expected output record.
Field types and null values follow the contract.
Dates, codes, statuses and totals are checked against the source.
No private data is transferred to a third-party service without permission.
Parsing, schema validation and factual review are treated as separate checks.
